name: cullin 3
pathways: negative regulation of Rho protein signal transduction

function.text: CUL3 encodes cullin-3. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin protein ligase activity and ubiquitin ligase complex scaffold activity. It participates in negative regulation of Rho protein signal transduction and cell migration.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); pseudohypoaldosteronism type 2E (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Papillary Renal Cell Carcinoma; Renal Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
